evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Cannot exclude small perforation at the inferior (articular) surface of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: Thinning and increased signal intensity of articular cartilages at the patellofemoral and medial tibiofemoral compartments are shown.
evidence.PF OA: chondromalacia (Grade II) at the meidlal tibiofemoral and patellofemoral compartments.
evidence.Effusion: Joint effusion and fluid in suprapatellar bursa are seen.

evidence.Fracture: No gross fracture or osseous destruction.
